command:
SELECT s.title, p.sales_30d, s.arm
FROM app.users u, shop.search(u.identifier, u.traits, 'wireless headphones', 5) WITH ORDINALITY s
JOIN shop.products p ON p.id = s.product_id
WHERE u.identifier = 'user-42' ORDER BY s.ordinality;
output:
title            | sales_30d |   arm   
-----------------------------+-----------+---------
 Steel Wireless Headphones   |         8 | control
 Eco Wireless Headphones     |         2 | control
 Cotton Wireless Headphones  |        87 | control
 Ceramic Wireless Headphones |         0 | control
 Ceramic Wireless Headphones |        49 | control
(5 rows)
